lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns; clusters posterior to the gill region exhibit lower spatial density and larger diameters compared to the anterior cluster region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like structural pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
